theme: Warm Light Mode (Blush, Nude, Champagne Gold)

headings.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif font-medium tracking-tight text-[#2A1E22]

visual_enhancers.card_style: bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md border border-[#EADCD7] rounded-2xl shadow-[0_10px_30px_rgba(212,115,133,0.06)] hover:shadow-[0_15px_35px_rgba(197,155,39,0.12)] transition-all duration-300

layout_strategies.hero_section: Asymmetric bento grid with high-impact hero photography, floating booking badge, real client rating pill, and instant 1-click booking flow trigger.
layout_strategies.service_catalog: Clean, structured 2-column or 3-column cards detailing service name, gel finish tags, exact duration (e.g., '1h 30min'), price (e.g., 'R$ 130,00'), and instant 'Agendar' action button.
layout_strategies.booking_flow_3_steps: Maximum 3 screens modal/drawer flow: Step 1: Escolher Serviço e Adicionais -> Step 2: Escolher Data e Horário (interactive grid) -> Step 3: Dados do Cliente + Confirmação via WhatsApp.
layout_strategies.admin_dashboard: Clean high-density command center for salon owner: Header switch between Hoje/Semana/Mês, Stats counters (Faturamento, Agendamentos, Clientes Ativos), Time Slot Blocker drawer, Service CRUD modal, and Client history drawer.

pwa_and_interactions.pwa_prompt: Custom styled banner / floating pill: 'Instalar App do Salão na Tela Inicial' with immediate trigger to save shortcut.
pwa_and_interactions.whatsapp_integration: Floating WhatsApp icon at bottom left + direct wa.me link generation after booking confirmation with pre-filled message: 'Olá! Gostaria de confirmar meu agendamento de [Serviço] no dia [Data] às [Horário] para [Nome].'
pwa_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Smooth state transitions on service tab selection, subtle scale effect on service cards, loading skeleton states for calendar loading, toast notifications using sonner.

component_guidelines.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive buttons, inputs, modals, calendar slots, tabs, and navigation links MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='book-service-btn-1', data-testid='admin-login-submit', data-testid='pwa-install-btn').

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast: Ensure text over light blush background meets APCA 4.5:1 ratio. Dark charcoal #2A1E22 for primary text.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Use 2x-3x generous padding (e.g. p-6 to p-10 on cards, py-16 to py-24 on major sections).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.transitions: Specific CSS transitions only (e.g. transition-colors duration-200, transition-transform duration-300). Never transition: all.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_emoji_icons: Do not use AI emoji characters for icons. Use lucide-react or @phosphor-icons/react icons exclusively.
